verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships an official CLI (`mint`) documented for local preview, validation, broken-link checks, and static export, and this was independently verified via npm install and command probe (mintlify-probe-rt-5), plus docs confirming install/usage (mintlify-docs-11, mintlify-probe-5). This directly satisfies the ai-native/agenticness CLI story with hands-on corroboration beyond just vendor docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party review or community discussion specifically praising/critiquing the CLI's workflow beyond the probe.
